strategies.confluences: Order Block mitigation, Fair Value Gap (FVG) retest, Change of Character (CHoCH), Liquidity Sweep execution, 24H VWAP Slope, High Volume momentum expansion.
strategies.slTpRules: Stop Loss set at local structural extreme +/- (stopOffsetMultiplier * ATR). Take Profit splits: TP1 (30% at 1.5R), TP2 (40% at 2.5R), TP3 (30% at 4.0R). Trailing stop anchors dynamically to structural swing fractals.
strategies.name: SMC Dynamic Confluence Engine
strategies.description: High-confluence Smart Money Concepts (SMC) quantitative strategy with dynamic confluence scoring, volatility-adjusted offsets, optimized scale-outs, and a mathematical E-Ratio circuit breaker.

strategies.confluences: EMA 200 Trend Filter + RSI Pullback + ATR Volatility-Adjusted Grid Spacing
strategies.entryRules: Identify trend using EMA 200 (Price > EMA 200 for Longs). Wait for an RSI pullback below 45 (for Longs) or above 55 (for Shorts). Deploy a 3-level limit grid with levels spaced at 1.0x ATR intervals from the trigger price.
strategies.name: Confluence Grid Scaler Pro
strategies.slTpRules: Hard Stop Loss for all grid layers is set at 2.0x ATR below the average entry price. Take Profit 1 is set at 2.0x Risk (1:2 RR) for 50% of the position. Take Profit 2 is scaled out at 4.0x Risk (1:4 RR) for the remaining 50% to maximize gains on high-confidence runs.
strategies.description: A smart grid system that only deploys grid layers in the direction of the major trend, using RSI pullback and ATR to filter bad entries and avoid crowded trend-reversal traps.

strategies.pattern: Bullish/Bearish Pin Bar Rejection at Key EMA Support/Resistance
strategies.entryRules: Buy when: 1. Price is above EMA 200. 2. A bullish Pin Bar forms (lower wick >= 2x body, body in upper 30% of range). 3. RSI(14) is below 40 (or recovering from oversold). Sell when: 1. Price is below EMA 200. 2. A bearish Pin Bar forms (upper wick >= 2x body, body in lower 30% of range). 3. RSI(14) is above 60.
strategies.confluences: Trend alignment (200 EMA), momentum exhaustion (RSI), and strict candlestick structure verification (wick-to-body ratio).
strategies.slTpRules: Stop Loss placed 2-5 pips beyond the tip of the Pin Bar wick. Take Profit set at 2.0x risk (1:2 Risk-to-Reward Ratio) or at the nearest key swing level.
strategies.name: Pin Bar Trend Confluence Pro
strategies.description: Trades high-quality pin bar rejection candles that occur in alignment with the 200 EMA trend and show RSI exhaustion confluences.

strategies.slTpRules: Stop Loss and Take Profit levels are automatically managed dynamically by Phase-2 AI Dynamic Exit Engine.
strategies.name: A+ Trend Confluence & Active Line Strategy
strategies.description: A high-probability trend-following and structural breakout model. It utilizes a custom Active Line (EMA/WMA blend) alongside EMA 20 and EMA 5 to identify momentum retests, structure alignment (HH/HL or LL/LH), and candlestick rejection signals at structural key zones.
strategies.pattern: Active Line Trend Alignment & Pullback Rejection
strategies.entryRules: Buy: Price > Active Line, Active Line > Active Line[1], and EMA 20 > Active Line. Market structure must confirm Higher Highs and Higher Lows. Wait for price to pull back to EMA 5, EMA 20, or the Active Line and print a bullish rejection candle (long lower wick or bullish engulfing). Enter long on a buy stop pending order set above the high of the signal candle when EMA 5 crosses above or curls upward from the Active Line. Sell: Opposite conditions apply.
strategies.confluences: Active Line Filter, EMA 20 Support/Resistance, Market Structure Swing Alignment, Candlestick Rejection (Engulfing/Pinbar), EMA 5 Momentum Trigger

strategies.entryRules: Identify trend using EMA 200 (Price > EMA 200 for Longs). Wait for an RSI pullback below 45 (for Longs) or above 55 (for Shorts). Deploy a 3-level limit grid with levels spaced at 1.0x ATR intervals from the trigger price.
strategies.slTpRules: Hard Stop Loss for all grid layers is set at 2.0x ATR below the average entry price. Take Profit 1 is set at 2.0x Risk (1:2 RR) for 50% of the position. Take Profit 2 is scaled out at 4.0x Risk (1:4 RR) for the remaining 50% to maximize gains on high-confidence runs.

strategies.name: Pin Bar Trend Confluence Pro

strategies.entryRules: Buy when: 1. Price is above EMA 200. 2. A bullish Pin Bar forms (lower wick >= 2x body, body in upper 30% of range). 3. RSI(14) is below 40 (or recovering from oversold).
